claims.text: Lower-limb immobilization w VTE risk > bleeding risk: consider LMWH or fondaparinux (NICE).
claims.quote: Consider pharmacological VTE prophylaxis with LMWH or fondaparinux sodium for people with lower limb immobilisation whose risk of VTE outweighs their risk of bleeding.
claims.locator: Venous thromboembolism in over 16s: reducing the risk of hospital-acquired deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism (NICE guideline NG89), Recommendations
